status: Original manual public trait impl body, not a provided default; only existing std next model

mapping.precondition: Default features on x86_64; valid generic iterator states in the Aeneas Iterator.next value/backward-state model, with a common Item type. Main Result/state delegation is unconditional in that model. A normal item/state result requires the selected inner iterator next call to return that result. No concrete iterator success/termination, bounds/count/fusedness, external or interior-mutability effects, Drop/panic/unwinding or independent Rust alias/lifetime guarantee is supplied.
